name: Horizon Explorer

abilities.text: Whenever you attack a player, create a Lander token.

notes: APPROXIMATION: the token op carries no granted ability, so the Lander is created as a plain colorless artifact token named Lander and its own "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: search for a basic land" ability (printed only as reminder text on this card) is not simulated. "Whenever you attack a player" is the `you-attack` event, which fires once per combat.

issues: create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.") — expected The Lander token has that activated ability — the token's defining text, not flavour reminder. Sacrificing it is the entire ramp payoff of the card. — scripted {op:'token', types:['Artifact'], keywords:[], name:'Lander'} — the core token op carries no granted ability (game.ts:1373-1386 builds tok.token from the effect's literal fields only), so the tokens are inert colorless artifacts that can never fetch a land. The script's aiHints still claim role 'ramp'. — CR 111.4 / 702.x — a predefined token's characteristics include its printed abilities

Whenever you attack a player, create a Lander token. — expected The 'attack a player' template triggers once for EACH player you attack with one or more creatures. — scripted event {on:'you-attack'}; game.ts:2275 fires it once when ctx.player === controller, i.e. once per combat no matter how many opponents were attacked. Identical in 2 seats, short by one or more tokens in the 4-seat games the sandbox also runs. — CR 506.2, 603.2

create a Lander token — expected a noncreature artifact token has no power/toughness — scripted power:0, toughness:0 on a types:['Artifact'] token — inert today, but it makes the token a 0/0 the moment anything animates it, and misdescribes the object. — CR 208.3

create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.") — expected The Lander is an artifact token carrying its own activated ability — the card's entire ramp payload. — scripted token op with keywords:[], no granted ability: a vanilla colorless artifact named 'Lander' that can never be sacrificed for a land. The script's notes call this an APPROXIMATION but there is no `needs`/`ignore` entry recording the loss. — CR CR 111.1, 113.3b

Whenever you attack a player, create a Lander token. — expected Triggers on attacking a PLAYER (and, in multiplayer, is about the attacked player). — scripted event {on:'you-attack'}, which game.ts:2275 fires as `ctx.player === perm.controller` for any attack declaration — it also fires when your only attacks are against a planeswalker or battle. — CR CR 506.2, 508.1

Lands you control enter untapped. — expected A replacement that makes your lands enter untapped. — scripted static enters-untapped {filter:{types:['Land']}, who:'you'} — handled by replacement.ts:500 (marks the permanent, untapped in the SBA pass before priority). Correct.
